title: Full Turkish casing
description_en: Use full locale-aware Turkish case mapping only for authorized derived text: I↔ı and İ↔i, including decomposed and non-adjacent combining-mark contexts. Preserve the original display name.
requirement: Use full locale-aware Turkish case mapping only for authorized derived text: I↔ı and İ↔i, including decomposed and non-adjacent combining-mark contexts. Preserve the original display name.

title: Mapping operations differ
description_en: Keep default Unicode casing, Turkish lowercase and casefold as separate operations; default İ→i+dot is not itself a Unicode bug to repair by deleting all dots.
requirement: Keep default Unicode casing, Turkish lowercase and casefold as separate operations; default İ→i+dot is not itself a Unicode bug to repair by deleting all dots.

title: Canonical equivalence is derived
description_en: Retain canonical-equivalent source bytes and the difference between ı and i. Define any normalization contract explicitly; neither stripping marks nor unconditional NFKC is a display repair.
requirement: Retain canonical-equivalent source bytes and the difference between ı and i. Define any normalization contract explicitly; neither stripping marks nor unconditional NFKC is a display repair.

title: Grapheme-safe ranges
description_en: Use extended grapheme boundaries and preserve source offsets for truncation, editing and highlighting; I+combining-dot must not be split into independent visual characters.
requirement: Use extended grapheme boundaries and preserve source offsets for truncation, editing and highlighting; I+combining-dot must not be split into independent visual characters.

title: Turkish collation
description_en: Separate sort and search purposes. Turkish c/ç, g/ğ, s/ş, o/ö, u/ü and dotted/dotless letters need locale-sensitive comparison; use the sign of compare results.
requirement: Separate sort and search purposes. Turkish c/ç, g/ğ, s/ş, o/ö, u/ü and dotted/dotless letters need locale-sensitive comparison; use the sign of compare results.

title: Search is not identity
description_en: A chosen base-sensitivity match for kar/kâr does not merge stored records or original spellings. Map any normalized match back to original grapheme boundaries.
requirement: A chosen base-sensitivity match for kar/kâr does not merge stored records or original spellings. Map any normalized match back to original grapheme boundaries.

title: Stable identifier separation
description_en: Keep display names, search keys, slugs and persistent IDs distinct; locale changes and transliteration collisions must not replace or merge stable records.
requirement: Keep display names, search keys, slugs and persistent IDs distinct; locale changes and transliteration collisions must not replace or merge stable records.

title: Content language spans
description_en: Declare actual tr content and override foreign spans appropriately; a product name or user string does not justify changing the language of a whole page.
requirement: Declare actual tr content and override foreign spans appropriately; a product name or user string does not justify changing the language of a whole page.

title: Syllabic hyphenation
description_en: Use reviewed Turkish syllable boundaries and a verified target dictionary. CSS feature availability is not evidence of correct tr hyphenation; manual soft hyphens require editorial review.
requirement: Use reviewed Turkish syllable boundaries and a verified target dictionary. CSS feature availability is not evidence of correct tr hyphenation; manual soft hyphens require editorial review.

title: Apostrophe at line end
description_en: When an apostrophe itself falls at line end, do not append a second hyphen, as in Ankara’ followed by dan; verify applicable single-letter isolation rules in the target output.
requirement: When an apostrophe itself falls at line end, do not append a second hyphen, as in Ankara’ followed by dan; verify applicable single-letter isolation rules in the target output.

title: Long-word overflow
description_en: Keep ordinary word shape and use layout or narrowly scoped overflow rescue before global break-all; displayed wrapping must not insert characters into copied source.
requirement: Keep ordinary word shape and use layout or narrowly scoped overflow rescue before global break-all; displayed wrapping must not insert characters into copied source.

title: Expanding labels and errors
description_en: Allow needed wrapping and height expansion in buttons, labels and explanatory errors; check narrow grids, fixed heights, marks and fallback in the target host.
requirement: Allow needed wrapping and height expansion in buttons, labels and explanatory errors; check narrow grids, fixed heights, marks and fallback in the target host.

title: Full text for truncated content
description_en: Provide an explicit keyboard- and touch-accessible route to full content. Do not hide essential action or error meaning behind ellipsis or a title attribute alone.
requirement: Provide an explicit keyboard- and touch-accessible route to full content. Do not hide essential action or error meaning behind ellipsis or a title attribute alone.

title: Actual font coverage
description_en: Record adopted files, versions, axes, subsets, styles and necessary glyphs. Font loading and family names do not prove the required Turkish glyphs were used.
requirement: Record adopted files, versions, axes, subsets, styles and necessary glyphs. Font loading and family names do not prove the required Turkish glyphs were used.

title: Dotted forms in shaping
description_en: Assess Turkish fi, small caps, italics and NFC/NFD marks with actual shaping and pixels; do not remove a dot or use synthetic styling as an untested repair.
requirement: Assess Turkish fi, small caps, italics and NFC/NFD marks with actual shaping and pixels; do not remove a dot or use synthetic styling as an untested repair.

title: Fallback is separate evidence
description_en: Test missing subset and font-outage cases; FontFaceSet.check does not prove every glyph is covered or rendered in the intended font.
requirement: Test missing subset and font-outage cases; FontFaceSet.check does not prove every glyph is covered or rendered in the intended font.

title: Typed numeric formatting
description_en: Keep values typed, distinguish a ratio from a percentage and use an explicit formatter. Verify 12.345,67 and %12,5 under a recorded runtime instead of replacing punctuation globally.
requirement: Keep values typed, distinguish a ratio from a percentage and use an explicit formatter. Verify 12.345,67 and %12,5 under a recorded runtime instead of replacing punctuation globally.

title: Currency representation contract
description_en: Distinguish the TRY code, ₺ symbol and editorial TL form. Do not append TL to an already formatted symbol amount or silently change currency.
requirement: Distinguish the TRY code, ₺ symbol and editorial TL form. Do not append TL to an already formatted symbol amount or silently change currency.

title: Date type and timezone
description_en: Keep locale, timezone, date-only values and instants as separate inputs; generate Turkish month/order with recorded formatter options rather than environment defaults.
requirement: Keep locale, timezone, date-only values and instants as separate inputs; generate Turkish month/order with recorded formatter options rather than environment defaults.

title: Grammar-specific apostrophes
description_en: Review Ankara’dan, Türk Dil Kurumundan, Türkçenin and Avrupa Birliği’ne by grammatical type. Generic suffix concatenation after every capitalized phrase is unsafe.
requirement: Review Ankara’dan, Türk Dil Kurumundan, Türkçenin and Avrupa Birliği’ne by grammatical type. Generic suffix concatenation after every capitalized phrase is unsafe.

title: Real text resizing
description_en: Check actual browser text resizing or zoom through 200% with documented exceptions; CSS transform scaling alone is not a successful user-zoom test.
requirement: Check actual browser text resizing or zoom through 200% with documented exceptions; CSS transform scaling alone is not a successful user-zoom test.

title: Measured reflow
description_en: Check the actual viewport at 320 CSS px equivalent, allowing meaningful two-dimensional exceptions; preserve content and function rather than shrinking text to hide overflow.
requirement: Check the actual viewport at 320 CSS px equivalent, allowing meaningful two-dimensional exceptions; preserve content and function rather than shrinking text to hide overflow.

title: User spacing resilience
description_en: Test simultaneous applicable line, paragraph, letter and word-spacing overrides. Accessibility test values are not default Turkish design tokens.
requirement: Test simultaneous applicable line, paragraph, letter and word-spacing overrides. Accessibility test values are not default Turkish design tokens.

title: Output and extraction
description_en: Inspect actual printed, PDF and slide output for marks, glyphs, wrapping, font embedding and extracted Unicode; each output medium has separate acceptance.
requirement: Inspect actual printed, PDF and slide output for marks, glyphs, wrapping, font embedding and extracted Unicode; each output medium has separate acceptance.

title: Prototype values are conditional
description_en: Choose type size, leading and tracking by medium, adopted font, audience and distance. Do not present trial values as an official Turkish typography standard.
requirement: Choose type size, leading and tracking by medium, adopted font, audience and distance. Do not present trial values as an official Turkish typography standard.
